title: Stop Learning n8n. Learn THIS Instead.

slides.text: Drag-and-drop automation platforms like n8n, Make, and Zapier were <accent>game-changers</accent>. But a new wave has arrived. <accent>Agentic workflows</accent> let you build the same automations in minutes, just by describing what you want in plain English.

slides.heading: The <accent>Market</accent> Has Spoken
slides.caption: Agentic AI market: $5.25B in 2024 -> $199B by 2034. A 38x increase.

slides.heading: 3 <accent>Waves</accent> of AI Automation
slides.caption: Wave 1: ChatGPT chatbots. Wave 2: AI + n8n/Make workflows. Wave 3: Agentic tools (Claude Code, Trigger.dev).

slides.heading: Old Way vs <accent>New Way</accent>
after: Describe what you want in English

slides.heading: Watch Out <accent>For</accent>
slides.body:
- Context drift: Agent forgets earlier instructions in long sessions
- Hallucinations: It invents functions or APIs that don't exist
- Over-engineering: Builds complex architecture for simple asks
- Always test. Never just take its word for it.

slides.text: Your n8n knowledge isn't wasted. It taught you triggers, data flow, error handling, and AI prompting. That's exactly what makes you better at directing agentic systems.

slides.heading: Key <accent>Takeaway</accent>
slides.body:
- n8n isn't dead. It became the foundation.
- Agentic workflows made everything faster.
- You still need to understand how workflows work.
- The skill is now directing, not configuring.
- Start learning Claude Code or any agentic tool today.
